name: delta-unresolved-resolver-limits
body: Two limits. (1) newly_real is O(delta nodes) and the resolver issues its label-split MERGEs plus one GC even when no seed unresolved row targets a new FQN; the GC scans the whole UnresolvedTarget table. Upgrade to a seeded-target index probe and a bounded GC only if this stage dominates a large-delta splice. (2) newly_real treats only status None or empty as real while the resolver's Cypher admits any status other than planned; a third code status would be skipped by the caller, so upgrade if a new code status is introduced.
